ema_strategy._lengths_note: Lengths are always 8/13/21/55 in BARS at the active chart interval (SIGNAL_INTERVAL): 55 bars = 55 half-hours on a 30m chart, 55 days on a 1d chart. Lengths never change; only the bar interval does. Smoothing: ALL FOUR lines are PLAIN EMA — matching the operator's chart, whose 'Three Moving Averages [AdventTrading]' indicator has shorttitle 'TEMA' but computes ema() x3 (verified from its Pine source 2026-06-15), plus a separate built-in EMA(8). DO NOT use TEMA (triple EMA) here: it overshoots in rallies, lifts the slow lines on top, and inverted BUY into SELL — force-liquidating the book on 2026-06-15.
ema_strategy.buy_signal: red EMA(55) crosses below ALL of EMA(8)/EMA(13)/EMA(21) — becomes lowest line
ema_strategy.sell_signal: red EMA(55) crosses above ALL of EMA(8)/EMA(13)/EMA(21) — becomes highest line. For a HELD position, SELL state itself (red on top) triggers the sell even if the cross happened on an earlier bar (no fresh EXIT transition required).
ema_strategy.hold_rule: when red EMA(55) is above all 3 — do nothing, stock is downtrending
ema_strategy.wait_rule: when red EMA(55) is below all 3 — hold position

learned_rules.rule: Enforce the confidence floor and reasoning-documentation at execution time, not just in research. A BUY is rejected unless confidence >= 60 (min_confidence_to_trade) AND both thesis and sources_used are non-empty.

observations_pending_confirmation.pattern: Low-beta 'diversifier/stability' positions admitted near the 60-65 band floor (e.g. T0007 HUM at 62) are prone to breakeven mechanical whipsaw exits on a 1h ribbon SELL state while the underlying thesis is intact or improving.
observations_pending_confirmation.candidate_rule: For low-beta sub-65-confidence stability positions, consider not force-exiting on a raw 1h ribbon SELL unless re-scored confidence also falls below 60.
observations_pending_confirmation.status: NOT APPLIED — single LOW-priority occurrence (T0007). Weakening the held-position SELL-state exit is a core exit-rule change requiring 3+ similar outcomes. Tracking only.

observations_pending_confirmation.pattern: Leveraged (>=2x daily-reset) ETFs entered intraday on a multi-day-old momentum/macro signal are exposed to severe whipsaw: a ~4% adverse move in the underlying becomes a double-digit loss on a 3x fund. T0010 (SOXL, 3x semis) was opened at the open near the morning high on a 5-day-stale 'momentum bullish Jun 11' thesis and lost -11.84% in ~2h on a mean-reverting tape.
observations_pending_confirmation.candidate_rule: For >=2x leveraged ETFs: (a) apply a leverage-adjusted stop (~5-6% on a 3x ≈ 10% single-name risk), (b) require same-day signal confirmation — no entry on a signal older than ~2 trading days, and (c) apply a fixed confidence penalty (~-10 pts) vs cash equities.
observations_pending_confirmation.status: NOT APPLIED — single occurrence (T0010). These are core risk-rule changes (stop threshold, signal-staleness gate, scoring penalty) requiring 3+ similar outcomes. Tracking only.
